# Asset Attribution

**Every asset in this project is original and generated by the project's
own code at runtime.** There are no downloaded models, textures, fonts,
audio files, or third-party media of any kind in the repository or the
served bundle.

| Category | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| 3D models (mech, monsters, city, hangar, props) | procedural — authored in `public/js/mechfab.js`, `monsterfab.js`, `cityfab.js`, `hangar.js`, `render.js` | project license (original work) |
| Textures (facades, asphalt, grunge, decals, clouds, sprites, deck plate, ads) | generated CanvasTextures in the same modules | project license (original work) |
| Music | procedural WebAudio sequencer, original composition rules (`public/js/music.js`) | project license (original work) |
| Sound effects | synthesized WebAudio (`public/js/sfx.js`) | project license (original work) |
| Fonts | system font stacks only (Segoe UI/Inter/Helvetica + platform monospace) | user's OS |
| Names, factions, monsters, callsigns | original fiction (AEGIS WATCH / Port Meridian / Abyssals) | project license (original work) |

## Code dependencies (not assets)

| Package | Use | License |
|---|---|---|
| three | rendering | MIT |
| cannon-es | server physics | MIT |
| express | static hosting | MIT |
| ws | websockets | MIT |
| playwright-core (dev) | E2E + visual tests | Apache-2.0 |

No franchise names, designs, logos, music or sound effects are referenced
or reproduced anywhere in this project.
